text:
michael: Heads up — planning to run MIG-2029 (user_preferences column split + staged backfill) in tonight's 23:00 UTC change window. Expect small exclusive locks on user_profile per-shard; overall rollout should be nonblocking but we need ops watch.

deploybot: MIG-2029 scheduled for 2025-11-12 23:00 UTC in release 2025.11.12. To cancel: /deploy cancel MIG-2029. Canary target: services pinned to v2.4.1 for 30m post-migration.

elaine: ack. can we avoid a single sweeping UPDATE? last time we saw brief deadlocks on writes.

olga: +1 — recommend chunked backfill job with small txn size. i'll add a batching worker that does 500 rows/txn and sleeps 100ms. should keep locks <200ms.

dan: what are rollback criteria? if backfill stalls for > 5m do we abort and roll back alter? need a clear signal.

michael: proposed rollback triggers: 1) lock_wait_seconds metric > 60s sustained for 2m, 2) db error rate for writes > 1.5% tier-wide, or 3) >3% of canary requests return 5xx. If any trigger fires, we abort remaining backfill batches and run the revert path (toggle feature flag + roll services back to v2.4.0).

elaine: add an automated alert in PagerDuty: create PD if lock_wait > 45s for 2m so humans can intervene before auto-abort.

sre-bot: alert rule created: infra.query.lock_wait > 45s (2m) -> PagerDuty: #oncall-db.

olga: backfill worker snippet (will run as k8s job):
```sql
-- chunked backfill example
BEGIN;
UPDATE user_profile
SET prefs_v2 = jsonb_build_object('ui', prefs->'ui')
WHERE id BETWEEN $START AND $END
LIMIT 500;
COMMIT;
-- sleep 100ms between batches
```

olga: will instrument job to emit metrics: backfill_rows_processed, last_batch_duration_ms, last_lock_wait_ms.

michael: release notes draft (short): "MIG-2029: split user_preferences into prefs_v2, backfilled via safe chunking. Services pinned at v2.4.1 during rollout. See ops runbook for rollback criteria." i'll paste to release-notes channel when ready.

dan: preflight checklist?

elaine: preflight steps: 1) run dry-run backfill on staging with same batch size 2) run schema apply on staging replica cluster 3) smoke test write+read flow 4) confirm canary pin works 5) dashboard panels created (lock wait, backfill progress, canary errors).

michael: i've added two hold points: before ALTER (hold if any replica lag > 10s) and after first 10k rows backfilled for canary check. deploybot will pause at holdpoints.

deploybot: holdpoints registered: PRE-ALTER and POST-10K-BACKFILL. To proceed manually: /deploy continue MIG-2029 PRE-ALTER or /deploy continue MIG-2029 POST-10K-BACKFILL.

olga: also: include a small compatibility shim in v2.4.1 so both prefs and prefs_v2 are read, write goes to both for 1 hour. reduces risk on rollback.

dan: good. what about long-running queries scanning user_profile that might get cancelled? add niced priority for backfill job so it yields to foreground queries.

olga: job will set statement_timeout=30s and work_mem low; will yield quickly.

elaine: release notes reminder: add migration safe note under "DB changes" and mention estimated downtime: none — brief shard-exclusive locks (<1s typical).

michael: monitoring dashboard links: https://console.internal/dashboards/MIG-2029-progress and alert links posted to #incidents. I'll post final release note entry 30m before window.

olga: one more: DB team request — if we see any deadlock_count > 5 in 10m, we immediately abort. add that to triggers.

michael: updated rollback triggers to include deadlock_count > 5 in 10m.

deploybot: MIG-2029 status: scheduled -> queued. Next automated message will be 22:45 UTC preflight check.

dan: thanks — i'll be on-call during the window. will watch ops and canary channels. :thumbsup:

elaine: ack, will standby for the PRE-ALTER hold.
